jp.kyasu.graphics.html

クラス DefaultHTMLReaderTarget

  • java.lang.Object
    • jp.kyasu.graphics.html.DefaultHTMLReaderTarget
  • すべての実装されたインタフェース:
    HTMLReaderTarget

    public class DefaultHTMLReaderTarget
extends java.lang.Object
implements HTMLReaderTarget
    The DefaultHTMLReaderTarget class is a default implementation of the interface for the target into which the html reader renders the HTML document.
    関連項目:
    HTMLReader, HTMLReaderTarget
